title: Puzzle (one round of the game)
description: A real recorded moment where a vehicle is about to cross a runway. Play `pre` up to `decision_t`, freeze, take the player's call, then show `ai` and play `reveal`. `reveal` and `outcome` are the hidden future: the UI must not render them before the player locks in.

t0_s.description: Puzzle t=0 is this many seconds into the recording

vehicle_time_shift_s.description: What-if puzzles only. The vehicle's own real crossing was replayed this many seconds away from when it really happened (negative = earlier), starting at decision_t. Everything else, including the aircraft, is exactly as recorded. Absent or 0 = fully real.

decision_t.description: Freeze time. pre frames have t <= decision_t; reveal frames have t > decision_t

zone_id.description: Crossing zone in map.json the vehicle is waiting to enter

aircraft_id.description: The aircraft the question is about

question.description: Shown at the freeze, e.g. 'Rescue 1 is holding short of RWY 4R at K. Clear it to cross?'

pre.description: What the player sees before the freeze. In fog mode these are OBSERVED positions (may be stale or lost).

age_s.description: Seconds since the last real update (0 outside fog mode)

status.description: When 'lost', x/y are the LAST KNOWN position

ai.description: The AI player's answer. It only used information up to decision_t.

p_safe.description: Model's raw probability that crossing now is safe

confidence.description: p_safe snapped to 50/75/95, used for the head-to-head score

paths.description: object id -> predicted positions after decision_t with 90% radius (draw as an uncertainty cone). Must include aircraft_id.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences, generated by the pipeline from the forecast

coach.description: Optional plain-English explanation of what really happened (Gemini add-on). Hidden until reveal.

baselines.description: Other detectors' calls on the same puzzle, for the results page

reveal.description: TRUE positions after decision_t, from the recording

conflict.description: min_sep_m < threshold_m while the vehicle was in the zone

min_sep_t.description: When the closest approach happened (draw a marker here)

note.description: Shown after the reveal, e.g. 'Closest approach 34 m at t=34 s'
